answer: Require every agent to post a small refundable bond before transacting, and weight its votes by a reputation score earned slowly through honest, verified work. A brand-new identity sits at the jetty in shallow water: it can do little until it proves reliability, so spawning thousands of sock puppets buys almost nothing. Misbehavior is carved in marble, recorded on-ledger, and slashes both bond and reputation, while steady good conduct restores a saffron standing that unlocks higher limits. One fake identity is cheap, but a thousand reputable ones is ruinously expensive.
